glp1r.name: GLP-1 receptor
glp1r.note: Human GLP-1 receptor, author chain R, with exendin-4, author chain P. Only exendin-4 residues 1–28 are resolved in this complex; residues 29–39 are absent, not fabricated. Gs and Nb35 omitted. Only experimentally modeled residues are shown; this is the agonist-bound conformation, not an activation trajectory.

cav22.name: CaV2.2 α1B pore-forming subunit
cav22.note: Human CaV2.2 pore-forming α1B subunit, author chain A, with ω-conotoxin MVIIA, chain B. Ancillary α2δ1 and β3 subunits, lipids, sugars and ions omitted. Gaps are unresolved residues; never connect backbone gaps exceeding 4.5 Å. Bound peptide pose is experimental.

integrin.name: αIIbβ3 integrin headpiece
integrin.note: One human αIIbβ3 headpiece (chains A and B) plus its bound tirofiban (AGG, author chain B). The second copy, Fab fragments, glycans, solvent and ions are omitted. This is the extracellular headpiece, not a full-length membrane receptor.
